name: hsr-filing
description: Evaluates whether a merger, acquisition, joint venture, LLC interest or minority stake requires a Hart-Scott-Rodino premerger notification under 15 U.S.C. 18a and 16 C.F.R. Parts 801-803, and prepares the filing workplan for attorney review. Values the deal (acquisition price, fair market value, assumed liabilities, deferred payments, previously held shares), applies the annually adjusted size-of-transaction and size-of-person thresholds and filing fee tiers with their effective date, identifies the ultimate parent entity and control, tests exemptions (ordinary course, investment-only, real property, foreign) against every condition, computes the 30-day or 15-day waiting period, screens interim covenants and integration plans for gun-jumping, and indexes Item 4(c) and 4(d) documents. Use for HSR filing, HSR threshold, premerger notification, filing fee, early termination, gun jumping, or Item 4(c) review. Routes deal terms to merger-agreement and tax to analyzing-m-and-a-tax-implications.
